titre: Can White queen the pawn? Build the bridge! ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
The Lucena position: White's pawn is on the 7th but the king is in front of it, and the black rook waits to check. Check the black king away, put the rook on the 4th rank (the bridge), walk the king out, and block the last check with the rook. Checked with Stockfish. Could you build the bridge? 👇

Analyze your own game, free: https://blundercheck.app/try?src=youtube-en
